content: IndiGo domestic flights include 15 kg check-in baggage (1 piece) and 7 kg cabin baggage. Additional prepaid baggage is charged at ₹500 per 5 kg block when booked in advance.
Air India domestic economy fares include 25 kg check-in baggage, 7 kg hand luggage, and complimentary hot meals on flights over 60 minutes.
Flexible rate bookings permit free cancellation up to 24-48 hours before check-in (12:00 PM local time). Non-refundable promo rates forfeit the initial deposit upon cancellation.

Hyderabad offers world-class vegetarian dining. Top spots include Chutneys (famous for steam dosa and 7 chutneys), Subbayya Gari Hotel (Andhra Bhojanam served on banana leaf with podi and ghee), and Tatva for fine dining.
For peaceful sightseeing, visit Qutb Shahi Tombs at 8:30 AM before tourist crowds arrive. Paigah Tombs near Pisal Banda feature intricate stucco mosaic work with virtually zero tourist crowds.
Louvre Museum and Musée d'Orsay require mandatory advance timed-entry reservations. Paris Museum Pass allows skip-the-line access across 50 monuments.

South Goa (Benaulim, Agonda, Arossim) provides secluded beaches and low crowd density compared to North Goa. Renting a self-drive scooter (₹400/day) or prepaid airport taxi is the most reliable transit.

Indian passport holders with a valid US, UK, or EU residence visa can obtain a 14-day Visa on Arrival at Dubai International Airport (DXB). Otherwise, a 30-day tourist eVisa must be arranged in advance.
